description: habits + checkins Drizzle tables and migrations with unique (habit, date)
spec:
1. Define a Drizzle `habits` table: id, name, cadence, notes, target, archivedAt, createdAt, updatedAt.
2. Define a Drizzle `checkins` table: id, habitId, date (YYYY-MM-DD), createdAt.
3. Add a unique constraint on (habitId, date) so a habit cannot be checked twice for one day.
4. Use snake_case DB columns mapped to camelCase TS fields.
5. Add a foreign key from checkins.habitId to habits.id via foreignKey({...}).onDelete(...).
6. Push the schema with `bun run --cwd backend db:push` and confirm tables exist.
7. Confirm the database file is created only in data/ at project root.
title: Habit and check-in schema
